groups.canonical_name: Cyberattacks on IT systems and data
groups.definition: Cyberattacks or security breaches of company IT systems could disrupt operations, compromise data, or lead to theft of proprietary information.
Unauthorized access to vehicle control systems could compromise vehicle safety, causing harm, liability and reputational damage.
Employees or former employees may misappropriate proprietary technology, eroding competitive position and potentially creating legal exposure.
Security vulnerabilities in the company's products could reduce customer demand and create liability and reputational harm.
